title: Depth-aware machine learning for 3D reconstruction of fibrous porous electrodes from FIB-SEM tomography
summary: The October 25, 2026 paper applies depth-aware machine learning to copper-coated polymer-fiber mats and compares reconstructions with independent physical measurements. The abstract supports improved morphology agreement, but identifies no separate electrode-property or materials discovery beyond validating reconstruction quality. This source check is limited to the abstract, electronic publication date and affiliations; the full paper was not assessed.
ai_technology: Depth-aware machine learning: monocular depth estimation plus unsupervised clustering
organization: Empa, Swiss Federal Laboratories for Materials Science and Technology; EPFL; ETH Zürich; European Synchrotron Radiation Facility

evidence.tested: Reconstruction agreement with porometry, pycnometry and X-ray tomography for one fiber-mat material system.
evidence.unknown: The complete Results and supplement were not reviewed. Exact reconstruction metrics, volume/sample details and full validation caveats were not assessed. The reviewed passages describe reconstruction agreement for Cu-coated PVDF-HFP fiber mats; any material-specific finding beyond method validation and any electrochemical-performance outcome remain unassessed.
evidence.ai_role: Monocular depth estimation model, trained on macroscale images, plus unsupervised clustering to separate in-plane from subsurface material in FIB-SEM slices.

source_review.scope: Indexed primary Wiley abstract, Introduction and pycnometry Methods passage, plus indexed primary PubMed abstract and publication metadata. Complete article Results and supporting information were not reviewed.
